e1b850abb7.q: What is BS 8878 and why is it significant for digital accessibility?
e1b850abb7.a: BS 8878 is the British standard for accessibility. It became one of the first digital standards in the world that actually consulted with autistic people, a group regularly excluded from accessibility standards, after an autistic expert provided detailed adjustment requirements for a meeting consultation.

556adfce71.q: What are the three main audiences for accessible events and meetings in organizations?
556adfce71.a: The three audiences are: customers or external attendees at large events; clients or stakeholders in business presentations; and internal staff members with disabilities who need all organizational communications and meetings to be accessible to them.

0f83bda091.q: What is the recommended minimum approach for organizations with limited budgets to make events accessible?
0f83bda091.a: Start with captions first, as they help the most people and have the lowest cost barrier. You can turn on automated captions in Zoom or even PowerPoint presentations without paying additional fees, though human captioning is more accurate than AI for specialized content.
